description: This PHP class defines a user role named ProjectAdminUserRole within a Human Resource Management system. It manages access rights to employees, projects, and customers based on the role's permissions and includes methods to fetch accessible entity IDs.

classes.name: ProjectAdminUserRole
classes.description: A user role class for project administrators that provides methods to retrieve accessible employee, project, and customer IDs based on permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Determines accessible entity IDs (employees, projects, customers) based on entity type and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIds
methods.description: Retrieves employee IDs accessible to the project admin, conditioned on specific permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleProjectIds
methods.description: Retrieves project IDs accessible to the project admin.

methods.name: getAccessibleCustomerIds
methods.description: Retrieves customer IDs accessible to the project admin.
